suggestions.title: “It’s still one grown-up doing three jobs …”
suggestions.where: The inner child, the guards, and the inner adult’s three jobs, P2

edits.before: Here I’m going to talk about what you develop in yourself as you reparent your inner child. I’m going to talk about it in terms of three jobs: your loving Nurturer, your safe Adult Protector (hereafter just the Protector) and your wise Guide. That’s one grown-up doing three jobs, not three more people moving in to help with the rent, and each job keeps the others in balance. Say a party gets to be too much for your little one. The Protector gets you both out of there, and on the way home the Nurturer tells them they did great, even though mostly they hid in the bathroom. And the Guide helps them think twice about the next weird party they might go to, avoiding another cycle of bathroom vacationing. 🙈 It’s you that needs to develop these qualities.
edits.after: Here I’m going to talk about what you develop in yourself as you reparent your inner child.
